crystal_multiplier.configuration.machine: Crystal Multiplier (machine)
Base energy multiplier
Global factor on the energy cost of every operation.
Base speed multiplier
Global base speed multiplier of every recipe.
Crystals per parallel lane
How many crystals of one kind form one parallel lane.
Config version
Format version of this config file, reserved for automatic migrations after a mod update. Leave it alone unless a changelog tells you otherwise.
Generated recipe: energy per tick
FE/t of the recipes this mod generates in code (addon crystals and registry scan). The three hand written json recipes keep their own numbers. Default 320.
Generated recipe: ticks
Ticks of a code generated recipe at 1x tier speed. Default 280.
Per item recipe overrides
One entry per line, "modid:item=energyPerTick:ticks" (for example "appflux:redstone_crystal=400:200"). Broken entries are ignored with a log warning.
Disable automatic recipes
When enabled the mod injects no recipes at all; only the three hand written json recipes (certus quartz, charged certus quartz, fluix) stay. Off by default.
Maximum parallel lanes
Upper bound of parallel lanes per machine.
Upgrade multiplier
Base factor of the Mekanism upgrade maths: value ^ (cards / cards possible). Default 10 = Mekanism default.
This machine: eject products every tick
When enabled the Crystal Multiplier pushes its output slots into adjacent containers / pipes every tick instead of Mekanism's default 10 tick interval. Crafting speed is not affected. On by default.
Global: every Mekanism machine ejects products every tick

When enabled every Mekanism machine (own machines, factories, addon machines) pushes its output slots every tick instead of the default 10 tick interval. Crafting speed is not affected. Off by default.
Cards per multiplier step
How many cards of one kind make one full multiplier step; default 8 matches the vanilla per-type cap, addons that raise the cap keep stacking beyond it.
Maximum seed slot capacity
Hard upper bound of the seed slot capacity.
Parallelism, seed slot, speed and energy settings of the Crystal Multiplier.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_seed: The seed is never consumed: it stays in the slot and only decides how much work the machine does.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_parallel: Parallel lanes = seeds divided by the crystals per lane (config crystalsPerParallel, 16 by default). Leftovers that do not fill a whole lane are ignored.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_speed_card: Speed cards do not make the machine run faster: each card adds parallel lanes (about 10x lanes with 8 cards).
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_energy_card: Energy cards only reduce the FE per tick (about 1/10 with 8 cards). They do not change speed or the seed slot.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_eject: Finished crystals are pushed out of the output slots automatically, once per tick when ejectEveryTick is on.
